title: Critical hits for GMs
source: Critical Rolls (Game Master's Toolbox), Nord Games, pp. 17–27. Open Game Content under OGL 1.0a.

columns.slashing: Wanna know how I got these? Double damage, and you receive a permanent scar on your face.

columns.magical: Midas touch. Quadruple damage, and your hands are permanently imbued with magical energy. Every non-living thing you touch is affected as if by the damage type taken.

columns.slashing: Unhand me! You lose a hand. You can no longer hold anything with two hands, and can only hold a single object at a time.
columns.piercing: Eye opener. You lose an eye, giving you disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and ranged attack rolls.
columns.bludgeoning: Dead leg. Your leg is smashed, and becomes broken beyond use. Your speed is halved, and you have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength and Dexterity.
columns.magical: Auditory annihilation. You are deafened. You automatically fail Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

columns.slashing: Vorpal strike. You must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, or be beheaded, and die.
columns.piercing: Heart piercer. You must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, or have your heart stabbed, and die.
columns.bludgeoning: Brain crusher. You must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, or have your head crushed, and die.
columns.magical: Arcane casualty. You must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, or be turned to dust, and die.
